answer: The atlas registry pings each agent ID with a surprise task at random moments. The answer must come back within two seconds, signed by the vault key that signed that ID's last ten jobs. Fifty fakes on one rack get overlapping pings, so the rack misses deadlines unless it runs fifty separate machines and keys. Each miss drags the ID's routing weight toward zero over a seven-day horizon. Every extra fake means another machine to rent and more pings landing at the same moment.
